**Finding: deviation (critical rule IP) — Section 13.5 Ownership**

- **Issue:** Section 13.5 says Developments created solely by Corio are owned by Corio, *"unless such Developments are supported on an ongoing basis by Commerce One in which case Commerce One will retain all ownership rights"* — an assignment of our own work product to the vendor with no licence back, contrary to our preferred position (we own what we create/pay for). The agreement also contains no statement that Corio's and its Customers' data on the Corio Servers stays ours.
- **Not flagged:** Commerce One's retained ownership of the Software (§2.8) and its pre-existing materials — vendor platform ownership is acceptable; Commerce One's assignment of any claim in Developments to Corio already benefits us.
- **Redline (validated ok:true):** deleted the ownership flip, substituted a nonexclusive, royalty-free licence to Commerce One to use such Developments only as needed to provide ongoing support, and added a data-ownership confirmation sentence.
